classes.cause: The command line did not parse, or a required argument was missing.
classes.impact: Nothing was read and nothing was written.
classes.title: Command usage error

classes.cause: plugin.json is missing a required field, carries an unknown field outside the reserved 'x-' namespace, or declares two keys that differ only by case.
classes.impact: The package is not installable; no file was staged.
classes.title: Manifest rejected by the strict parser

classes.cause: A staged path is not matched by the deny-by-default allowlist, or matches a forbidden pattern (.git, caches, logs, transcripts).
classes.title: Payload violates the include allowlist

classes.cause: The deny-by-default secret gate matched high-entropy or key-shaped content in a file that was about to be shipped.
classes.impact: No archive was written. The finding names the file and the offset, never the value.
classes.title: Credential-shaped content found in the payload

classes.cause: The staged payload is larger than the declared budget, which is how a 2 GB accident is caught before it ships.
classes.title: Package exceeds its size or file-count budget

classes.cause: Insufficient disk space, an unwritable prefix, or a missing parent directory.
classes.title: Preflight refused the operation

classes.cause: A concurrent install/update/rollback/uninstall is in progress, or a previous run died holding the lock.
classes.title: Another lifecycle operation holds the prefix lock

classes.cause: A staged step raised after the journal opened; the inverse of every applied step was replayed.
classes.impact: The prefix is back at its pre-operation state. No partial install remains.
classes.title: Transaction failed and was rolled back

classes.cause: Live and repo both hold unique content for the same path, so neither side can be overwritten without losing something.
classes.impact: The file was left untouched and a decision packet was written.
classes.title: Diverged file needs an owner decision

classes.cause: A content-addressed entry does not hash to its own key.
classes.impact: The entry was quarantined; the operation continues from source.
classes.title: Cache entry corrupted or unreadable

classes.cause: At least one registered probe returned FAIL.
classes.impact: Nothing was mutated. The report names each probe and its remediating command.
classes.title: Health check reported a failing probe

classes.cause: The package violates the plugin contract (manifest, interpreters, layout, or schema of an emitted artifact).
classes.title: Conformance validator rejected the package

classes.cause: A migration step raised, or a legacy fingerprint matched two mutually exclusive layouts.
classes.impact: The ledger holds the inverse of every applied step; nothing is half-migrated.
classes.title: Migration from an old layout failed

classes.cause: The manifest's compatibility range excludes the detected client version, or the platform has no launch adapter.
classes.title: Client, OS, or shell is not supported

classes.cause: A script entrypoint names an interpreter that is absent from PATH or older than the declared floor.
classes.impact: Nothing was mutated. Scripts are never run through an inferred interpreter.
classes.title: Declared interpreter missing or below its version floor

classes.cause: A path escaped its root, used a reserved device name, or exceeded the platform path limit.
classes.impact: Nothing was written at that path.
classes.title: Filesystem operation refused
